summary: Fixed gridcalc to follow the docs: exponent number tokens, prefix minus looser than ^ and ^ right-associative, column numbering (AA=27), range normalisation and membership, refs dedupe, %.10g number text, numeric text skipped in SUM/AVERAGE/MIN/MAX ranges, undefined cells read as empty, lazy IF, bool cell typing, cell-order sorting of documents, space/tab-only stripping in sheet lines, and overflow/ROUND robustness. All 58 unit tests pass and tools/check.py reports no broken rules.
